wallclock_seconds.scope: Local elapsed runner work; excludes gaps between invocations and final result-file write; shared batch setup is separate

setup_seconds.scope: Per-run local loading, model conversion and validation

sampling_seconds.scope: Local sampler/final gate-sampling call; not device computation time

postprocessing_seconds.scope: Local result decoding, exact repair and scoring

device_seconds.scope: Provider-reported device usage; may be rounded/billable, not device elapsed time

device_sample_computation_seconds.scope: Sum of QCI per-sample runtime values; excludes separately reported device preprocessing/postprocessing

provider_processing_wallclock_seconds.scope: QCI provider processing interval, including provider I/O

provider_queue_seconds.scope: QCI detailed wall.queue interval; endpoints differ from job-status timestamps

provider_total_wallclock_seconds.scope: QCI detailed wall.start-to-wall.end interval; endpoints differ from job-status timestamps

device_access_seconds.scope: D-Wave qpu_access_time: reported charged QPU access interval, including programming and sampling

device_sampling_seconds.scope: D-Wave qpu_sampling_time: anneal/readout/delay cycles; not QCI sample-computation scope

run.execution_context_source: Solver label and recorded historical metadata

samples.occurrence_weighting: Counts and empirical rates include num_occurrences; distinct counts collapse repeated bitstrings

quality.cost_basis: Original feasible process-design objective; compare costs only within the same case
quality.selection_definition: Unit selections and ionic pair define an option; feasible routes are grouped within it.
quality.rate_basis: Observed occurrence-weighted frequencies from this run; not exact gate probabilities or independent-run uncertainty

energy.basis: Canonical binary objective including offset; surrogate/model energy is distinct from original feasible cost

optimization.exact_probability_basis: Trained ideal-circuit distribution; separate from observed read frequencies

comparison.timing_reference: timing: seconds with per-field scope, source and availability; overlapping intervals are not additive
